## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you would like to see.

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...").

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. What persona, intelligence engine, API, or widget should be added or modified?

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any mockups, API references (e.g. Open-Meteo models, NOAA, Copernicus), or additional context here.
